exposure: Advanced chronic kidney disease (CKD stage 4 and 5)
advanced chronic kidney disease (CKD stage 4 and 5)
Mild CKD (eGFR 45-100 mL/min and pre-pregnancy proteinuria)
severe CKD (defined as estimated GFR < 30 mL/min)
cohort: Pregnant women with severe CKD (eGFR < 30 mL/min) and mild CKD
finding: Compared to women with mild CKD, women with severe CKD had higher rates of pre-term delivery and a higher average eGFR reduction during pregnancy, but similar rates of caesarean section, pre-eclampsia, and adverse fetal outcomes.
mod_finding: Both groups had similar rate of caesarean section.
